title: BNSMapperSectionList
description: Schema for IPC to BNS sections mapping dataset

id.description: Unique identifier for the mapping, e.g. ipc-302

ipc.description: IPC section number, or 'Omitted' / 'None' if brand new in BNS

bns.description: BNS section number, or 'Omitted' if removed in BNS

title.description: Subject title of the offence or provision

chapter.description: Legal chapter or category (e.g. Offences Affecting the Human Body)

change.description: Nature of the transition from IPC to BNS

old_text.description: Verbatim or key extract from the Indian Penal Code, 1860

new_text.description: Verbatim or key extract from the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023

explanation.description: Plain-English explanation of the change and practical implications

verified.description: Whether the entry has been verified against the official gazette

source.description: Official gazette citation, parliamentary report, or authoritative reference
